title: DOE says it cannot locate Kettle 2 footage
summary: Jesse Michels tells of DOE says it cannot locate Kettle 2 footage, about 2023 at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: The Department of Energy responded saying that they were unable to locate the footage.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in October 2023 a formal request was filed, linked to a man named Jeffrey Cruickshank, asking the government to review and release secret footage known as Kettle 2. According to Michels, the Department of Energy answered that it could not find the footage, which he raises as a sign that records are missing or kept out of reach.
